notes:
POC focused solely on Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) for latency-sensitive chat and embeddings workflows. Key ask: predictable throughput and 95th pct latency SLOs under representative load.
- Customer: trading platform: real-time client chat + intraday risk summarization + similarity search for compliance.
- Primary constraint: US data residency + VPC-only. No public-hosted data in initial rollout.
- Initial sizing ask: support ~200 concurrent chat sessions (avg 12 messages/session) with 512-token context and 95th pct latency < 150ms for response tokens. Also embedding pipeline: ingest 200k docs/day, target embedding throughput 5k/sec.
- Hardware preference: H100-class instances preferred by infra team; open to quantified perf profile recommendations.
- SLA negotiation: want 99.95% uptime, credits for missed latency SLOs; legal wants explicit rollback/failover playbook for Dedicated -> Hosted fallback.
- Pricing sensitivity: committed reserved capacity, willing to contract 12-24 months if perf guarantees + quantized TCO provided.
- Quote from CTO: "we need predictable tails more than raw median throughput; if we can map unit economics and worst-case tail, we sign."
- Internal notes: procurement cycles long; security signoff in parallel (expect 3 weeks).

poc_summary:
Goal: validate Dedicated reserved cluster can achieve agreed throughput and latency SLOs for chat + embedding workloads and produce a sizing+SLA recommendation.
- Tests run: synthetic QPS ramp, burst storms, backpressure/queueing scenarios, and 72h soak with steady-state 60% load.
- Representative prompts: live chat transcripts (intent detection + tool calls), compliance rerank prompts (long context ~4k tokens), embedding batches (up to 1M vectors over 12h).
- Metrics captured: p50/p95/p99 latency for generation and token emit, tokens/sec per GPU, GPU utilization, memory/KV cache hit rate, error/retry rates, cost per 1M tokens.
- Acceptance criteria: p95 < 150ms for chat generation (512 ctx), sustained embedding throughput >=5k/sec with <0.5% error, stability over 72h with no growth in retry rate.
- Outcome so far: throughput targets met; p99 spikes during 1-2s bursts identified (batching config and routing tweaks recommended).
ops_requirements: Autoscaling preferences: prefer scheduled reserve with burst pools; customer wants explicit warmup procedures for cold cache restoration. Tracing: require request-id propagation into Redwood Console and ability to pull token-level traces for post-mortem. Backup: snapshot KV cache policy and cold-start SLA. Failover: documented fallback to Hosted endpoint with tokenization compatibility checks.
